name: Caltronics Design & Assembly
old_description: Caltronics is a PCB Assembly Company that Specializes in Finding the Right Solution for your projects
about:
Caltronics Design & Assembly was founded in 1995 in Stacy, Minnesota, as a family-owned PCB assembly company focused on helping inventors, design engineers, and businesses bring products to market. The firm began by offering complete solutions from concept to prototype and final production, combining design engineering with manufacturing under one roof.

The company provides electronic design, PCB design, and full PCB assembly services, including rapid prototyping, design for test, design for manufacturing, electronic product design, electronics testing, electromechanical assembly, PCB potting, and conformal coating. Production uses a MY700 jet printer, selective solder machine, and 3D automated optical inspection equipment, supporting prototyping through production volumes.

Caltronics serves commercial, defense and aerospace, medical device, military and law enforcement, renewable energy, solar, sports and outdoors, automotive, navigation, and lighting sectors. Customers range from individual inventors to established firms requiring ITAR-compliant assemblies for defense applications.

The company emphasizes big-company experience with small-company service, retaining family ownership while maintaining a global presence. Its ISO 9001:2015 certification and ITAR registration underscore a commitment to quality and compliance, and the firm highlights in-house support from ideation through production as a key differentiator.
